findings.title: Server-limitation admission rejects every structurally valid call-chain reference
findings.affected_requirement: The reopened limitation/target shard must accept a closed, hash-bound limitation evidence graph and create the limitation record exactly once.

evidence.detail: record_server_limitation() requires each call_chain item to have path, sha256, and stage, then passes the full item to _verify_limitation_reference(). That helper requires the reference key set to be exactly path and sha256, so every valid call-chain item is rejected before the limitation evidence can be admitted. The exact regression is exercised by orchestrator_harness/tests/test_firmware_acceptance_kit.py:183-187.

findings.reproduction_and_impact: The exact authorized command ran 20 tests and errored in FirmwareAcceptanceKitTests.test_server_limitation_create_once_has_causal_and_c3_evidence with AdmissionError: limitation call chain reference is not closed. The fixture supplies the required {path, sha256, stage} chain shape; the implementation's exact-key helper rejects it deterministically. Consequently a valid pinned-server limitation cannot be recorded, and the reopened limitation path cannot reach its create-once and causal-evidence assertions.
findings.smallest_fix: Validate the chain item's path and sha256 fields while permitting its required stage discriminator, or pass a path/sha256-only projection to the generic reference helper and retain the explicit stage-shape check. Preserve the exact stage/order validation and add the authorized create-once test as the regression gate.
findings.implementation_complexity: Low: localized reference-shape handling in the limitation admission path.
findings.regression_risk: Low: the correction would affect only the already-closed limitation call-chain validation and would retain hash, path, stage, identity, and ordering checks.
findings.verification_cost: Low: rerun the same two authorized unittest modules; no MCP, hardware, server, or physical resource is required.
findings.cost_benefit_reasoning: This is a directly demonstrated functionality break in the assigned acceptance kit, blocking all valid server-limitation admissions. A narrow shape-handling correction has materially lower complexity, regression risk, and verification cost than leaving the required limitation route unusable.
